ROOM AND SPATIAL DEPTH: same warm plaster craft cottage, camera at human seated eye level, approximately 50mm f/4, clear spatial separation of foreground worktable, a strip of floor behind it and low oak yarn cubbies 1.5 meters further back on the right. Shelf holds a modest assortment of unlabelled differently oriented cream, gray-blue and pale warm yarn, irregularly stored, no duplicated rows. Balanced highlights, no flare or light particles. Aged plank floor recedes toward baseboard, softly worn jute rug at bottom. The table has fine dents, coherent board grain, old joints, subtle use marks and worn edge, not exaggerated distressed wood.

PRODUCTS: six principal unlabelled yarn balls on foreground right tabletop in a loose asymmetric arrangement with breathable gaps and overlaps, not a symmetrical product pyramid. Fibers sharply resolved, correct contact shadows. Relative scene position:
1. x=69%, y=60%, caramel/apricot boucle round center-pull ball from s1_圈圈纱, soft irregular small loop structure and slightly loose winding, visible hole at an oblique angle. Fine little loops, NOT popcorn chenille or giant knots. Use reference caramel shade, not brand recoloring.
2. x=84%, y=56%, s1_魔法球 feather long-fiber cake tilted in three-quarter view, visible sidewall and spiral face. Peach/salmon core, pale blush and ivory midrings, icy baby aqua-blue outer rings; delicate feathery long filaments, distinct from mohair. Not a smooth disk facing camera or cotton candy cloud.

5. x=62%, y=74%, small ivory s1_莫兰迪8美利奴, smooth medium plied yarn, naturally cross-wound rounded ball, reference exact creamy ivory.
6. x=94%, y=78%, misty powder gray-blue merino from same reference, a different three-quarter orientation and winding, visible twisted plies, very little halo. Do not stylize into identical spheres.

BRAND COLOR THROUGH ENVIRONMENT: terracotta ceramic cup on rear shelf, a small faded terracotta linen fold partially visible under far-right edge of table arrangement; a tiny butter-yellow linen hem beside it. Restrained tangible accents, keep yarn colors reference-true, avoid overall orange color grading. One small closed embroidery scissors on foreground right, two proper brass handle loops, steel blades joined with a coherent pivot and meeting tips. No extra tools, plants, baskets, vases or staged decorative collection.

QUALITY: authentic premium lifestyle magazine photograph, believable optical depth, crisp main yarn structure with moderate softening only of distant shelf, natural exposure, fine material detail, richer depth and light than failed d1. No illustration, CGI, plastic, glowing hair, excessive bloom, fake bokeh, repeated cloned balls, impossible strands, malformed scissors. No people, animals, labels, text, digits, watermark, logos, packaging or paper. Maintain quiet safe areas without making the entire room an empty flat wall.
